findings.problem: LeaseWorkflow uses pub status: String with no domain constraints, allowing any string value including contradictory states like status="pending" paired with is_sent=true
findings.failure_mode: Invalid workflow states are constructable, causing silent logic errors when callers branch on status strings or is_sent flags that disagree
findings.fix: Replace status: String and is_sent: bool with a single LeaseStatus enum typestate (e.g., enum LeaseStatus { Draft, Validated, Sent { sent_at: Timestamp } }) and make all fields private behind a fallible constructor

findings.problem: is_validated: bool and is_sent: bool are primitive lifecycle flags that duplicate and conflict with the status field. Three bools/strings can express 8*infinite states, most of which are illegal
findings.failure_mode: Callers can create structs with is_validated=false, is_sent=true, status="sent" — a state that should be impossible by domain invariants
findings.fix: Replace all three fields (status, is_validated, is_sent) with a single typed LeaseStatus enum that encodes the valid lifecycle transitions

findings.problem: All fields are pub struct fields with no private constructor, no fallible new(), and no invariant enforcement. Callers can construct any combination of fields
findings.failure_mode: Any caller outside this module can create LeaseWorkflow with contradictory field combinations, bypassing all domain invariants
findings.fix: Make all fields private, add a fallible fn new() -> Result<LeaseWorkflow, LeaseError> that validates initial invariants, and expose only domain-safe accessors

findings.problem: id: String and sent_at_epoch_ms: Option<u64> are raw primitives with no domain semantics. Any u64 or String is accepted, including zero, max, or empty string
findings.failure_mode: Sent at epoch 0 or u64::MAX is accepted without validation; empty string IDs pass as valid identifiers
findings.fix: Replace with newtypes LeaseId(String) with a validated constructor and Timestamp(u64) with a constructor that rejects zero/invalid values

findings.problem: mark_sent unconditionally sets status to "sent" and is_sent to true without checking any precondition (e.g., the lease must be validated first). The function name implies a workflow step but accepts any state
findings.failure_mode: A lease can be marked sent without being validated, violating the business workflow invariant that validation precedes sending
findings.fix: Replace mark_sent with a fallible fn try_mark_sent(self) -> Result<LeaseWorkflow, LeaseError> that checks the current status is Validated before transitioning to Sent

findings.problem: status field is String and mark_sent does "sent".to_string() on every call, allocating a fresh heap string. With an enum typestate this would be zero-allocation
findings.failure_mode: Unnecessary heap allocation on every state transition, violating zero-copy and performance defaults
findings.fix: Use a LeaseStatus enum; the transition becomes a pure enum variant assignment with zero allocations

findings.problem: No tests module exists. The crate has no behavioral contract verification for type invariants, workflow transitions, or error paths
findings.failure_mode: No evidence that the domain model behaves correctly; regression-prone with zero safety net
findings.fix: Add a tests module covering: (1) invalid state construction is rejected, (2) valid workflow transitions succeed, (3) invalid transitions are rejected by constructors, (4) mark_sent preconditions are enforced

missing_evidence: no benchmark exists for state transition performance
no profiler data for allocation profiles of mark_sent
no allocation audit for the String fields and .to_string() call
no behavior tests for workflow invariants and typestate transitions
no command evidence of cargo test, cargo fmt, or cargo clippy execution
residual_risk: The LeaseWorkflow type is fundamentally broken for Holzman Rust delivery. All three lifecycle fields are independent primitives that can express illegal states. mark_sent has no precondition enforcement. No tests, benchmarks, or clippy evidence exist. The entire domain model requires redesign with a single typed enum typestate before this crate can be delivery-grade.
